name: XformPauliVTA
summary: Transforms the Pauli atlas ventral tegmental area (VTA) probability map from MNI space into subject space with ANTs, then optionally thresholds, binarises and splits it into left and right ROIs.
description: Optionally brain-extracts the ACPC-aligned T1 with FSL bet, computes an ANTs affine and warp between the subject and the bundled MNI152 1 mm template, applies the inverse to the Pauli VTA probabilistic map, thresholds it at maskThreshold, binarises it with FSL and splits it by hemisphere with AFNI. Use the resulting VTA ROIs as seeds for tractography.

inputs.description: Subject T1 is used to compute transform files for Pauli VTA ROI.

outputs.description: Output directory for ROI nifti files
Output directory for ANTs xform files

parameters.description: Toggles script to run BET brain mask extraction.
Performs binarization of thresholded VTA ROI.
Splits thresholded and binarized VTA ROI into left and right hemispheres.
Threshold value for voxel inclusion in xformed VTA ROI.
